en: Well, look at that! A Champion, and on my doorstep. Come in, come in, and mind the shavings.
This is where I make things. Every Pokémon sheds something as it battles, and the countryside gives a good deal more to anyone who knows where to look.
I can't turn you into a craftsman in an afternoon. But I can hand you a kit. Here, it's yours.
Keep it in your bag. When a wild Pokémon is beaten or caught, whatever it leaves behind goes into the kit's pouch by itself, and you'll be told so once the battle is over.
Open it whenever you like to see what you're holding. The rest I'll show you when my bench is ready.
Back again! Your kit's still in good order, I hope.
What can I do for you?
Then I'll get on. Mind the shavings on your way out.
Every wild Pokémon leaves something of its own kind behind: a common thing almost every time, a rare one now and then. The higher its level, the more there is.
Trainers' Pokémon leave nothing, nor do the ones in a contest or a park. Those are sport, not the wild.
